crag.name: Oppmannaberget
crag.access_info:
❗️IMPORTANT INFO❗️

🤫 "Kungasalen" is close to some houses and often visited by hikers – be respectful and keep a low profile here!
🗑 Remove all of your trash!
🧹 Brush off tickmarks and excessive chalk!
🚜 Park so that large vehicles can pass by!

PARKING
• The Parkings are marked on the map.

APPROACH
• See the GPS trails on the map.
• You can easily walk from Lilla väggen to Jutmanberget to Bullseye.
